pages.title: A Coin in the Hand
pages.text: Learn how your balance becomes cash.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Open Wallet and choose an available withdrawal of your own funds. A committed withdrawal counts once; the quest does not create coins.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Money is accessed through Shipping's money tab; withdrawal turns value into physical coins rather than creating another balance.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: On a server, finish its displayed authentication flow first; passwords belong only in that native procedure and are never published. Online sessions and integrated owners have their own principals. A compatibility icon does not fix mismatched mods or channels.
